notes.subject: וּמוֹצִיאִי
notes.rationale: participle construction 'and my bringer-out' rendered as relative clause with supplied subject markers

notes.subject: jaɲɛ
notes.rationale: חמסים 'violences' rendered with singular 'jaɲɛ' (injustice/violence); Hebrew plural of intensity

notes.subject: i bɛ ne lamini
notes.rationale: תַּצִּילֵנִי is imperfect 'you deliver me', not future; rendered with habitual bɛ

translation: Min bɛ bɔ a yɛrɛ ma ko ne bɔ a yɛrɛ la n'ka tɔrɔtɔrɔbagaw fɛ, ani min bɛ ne jɔ ka tɛmɛ minnu bɛ ne kan wuliwuli la; mɔgɔ min ye jaɲɛ kɛ, ne tigɛli la i bɛ ne lamini.

tokens.gloss: ani minnu bɛ ne kan wuliwuli
i bɛ ne jɔ ka tɛmɛ
